scope: First-order forward finite-difference sensitivity of DripTray FEA metrics with respect to size-z, at the reviewed 30 mm R2 baseline.
evidenceBoundary: Produces a local finite-difference derivative (value and unit) of each declared FEA metric with respect to DripTray size-z at the reviewed 30 mm R2 baseline, step h = 1 mm. Not a pass/fail verdict, not a requirement evaluation, not a conformance claim, and not a certification. Both runs use the same mesh target and solver parameters; residual remeshing variation is part of the measured derivative and is not hidden.

domain.localValidityNote: Linear approximation valid only near the declared 30 mm base. The step h = 1 mm bounds the local region; results must not be extrapolated to large corrections or other components.
limitations: Step h = 2 mm rejected: the perturbed geometry at 32 mm has a Z half-extent of 16 mm, which exactly contacts the declared selection-box boundary (z = plus-or-minus 16 mm, margin = 0 mm). This reproduces the R2 selection-box failure that required the R3 recovery. Step h = 1 mm keeps a 0.5 mm margin on the perturbed face (31 mm, Z half-extent = 15.5 mm).

Both runs share the same selection boxes (z = plus-or-minus 16 mm, copied from proof-case R3, designed for 30 mm geometry). The 0.5 mm margin at the perturbed 31 mm geometry is acceptable but has not been validated by a dedicated reviewed proof.

The measured derivative includes Gmsh remeshing variation. Two runs at the same mesh target do not produce bitwise-identical meshes; this noise is not separated from the geometric signal in the reported derivative.
